messages:
maria: Kickoff — Q2 perf gating and launch checklist. We need explicit canary metrics for kernel, quant, and KV cache changes.
jonathan: +1. Sales asks: p50 <= 50ms, p99 <= 350ms for short-chat flows; embeddings throughput target is 3x current.
kevin: Plan sketch: kernel micro-optimizations week1, quant staged rollout week2, KV prefix cache and TTL controls week3.
olga: Whats the rollback path if we see quality regressions after quant?
tim: Rollback = model-variant routing + disable quant profile -> fallback to fp16 kernel. Canary traffic: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
maria: Proposed gating metrics:
- latency: p50 / p95 / p99 vs baseline
- quality: eval-set pass rate >= 98% (selected prompts)
- cost: tokens/sec improvement >= 20% at simulated 95th-load
jonathan: Also add SLO smoke: tail (p99) absolute increase < 10% compared to baseline.
kevin: Canary control example (for routing config):
```json
{
  "route": "canary-quant",
  "percent": 5,
  "metrics": ["p99_latency", "nll", "embedding_cosine"]
}
```
olga: Who owns the evaluation harness? @maria
maria: I will. Ill create the eval runbook + thresholds dashboard. ETA: Thu EOD.
tim: Need perf-runner changes to simulate 95th-percentile batch sizes and realistic KV hit/miss patterns. I can add load scripts to perf-ci.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/kernels/patch-542 -> staging (build 542.7) :white_check_mark:
jonathan: Note: Dedicated customers requested per-tenant KV cache TTL controls. Backlog this — not gating for this patch but schedule after canary.
maria: Agreed. Prioritize per-tenant TTL in backlog after rollout.
kevin: Open decision: quantization granularity. Im leaning per-layer first to reduce quality risk and enable targeted rollbacks.
olga: Launch checklist items (short): unit tests, perf bench, eval pass, canary phases, rollback playbook, docs + runbook.
maria: Canary cadence proposal: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> 100% for 48h if metrics stable. If eval NLL worsens > 0.5 we pause and investigate.
tim: Ill wire Prometheus alerts and a small dashboard with p50/p95/p99, nll, embedding cosine, and KV hit rate. Add runbook link after created.
maria: Thanks — Ill post the launch checklist doc once it exists and tag this thread.
jonathan: Ill sync with sales about customer timelines and let you know any hard deadlines.
kevin: Starting the kernel PR now (patch-542). Will post perf numbers in PR description.
olga: Im taking oncall for the first 72h post rollout.
maria: Closing for now; will reopen with checklist link and canary schedule updates.
